speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: The lab results showing "NORMAL READINGS" are too vague to be useful for ruling out specific infectious etiologies in a pregnant patient. Given the strong epidemiological clue of consuming ice cream three days prior to symptom onset, I need to confirm the specific pathogen. Did the ice cream contain unpasteurized milk or soft cheeses? REQUEST TEST: Listeria monocytogenes culture and PCR. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain to rule out listeriosis meningoencephalitis.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Listeria monocytogenes culture: Positive; MRI Brain: Normal.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection). The positive culture from your Listeria test confirms the diagnosis, which aligns with your recent consumption of potentially contaminated food and current pregnancy status. The normal MRI rules out central nervous system complications, indicating the infection is likely bacteremia or localized sepsis.
